g: (astrophysics, cosmology) A rotating black hole that extracts energy from its rotation and magnetic fields to emit a jet of particles and radiation.
The buzzing sound of a bee, wasp, etc.
(intransitive, informal) To make a buzzing sound like that of a bee or wasp.
(onomatopoeia) The sound of a game show buzzer or of electricity. Often used as a reaction to a wrong answer.
